d.title: Ryuuou no Oshigoto!
d.en: The Ryuo's Work is Never Done!
d.jp: りゅうおうのおしごと!
syn: สอนหมากหนูที คุณพี่จ้าวมังกร!
d.synopsis: 16 year old Kuzuryuu Yaichi has fallen into a slump after winning the major shogi title "Dragon King", the pressure of his losses continue until an elementary schooler called Hinatsuru Ai, with an extraordinary shogi talent, arrives at his doorstep.
